Annual gross revenue. Based on trailing 12-month AirROI performance of 6 comparable properties. AirROI measures occupancy over the full 365-day year.

How the base case is derived: We combine two independent AirROI methods: the median trailing-12-month revenue of the 6 comparable listings ($85,506) and AirROI's revenue estimate for a 4-bedroom, 4.5-bath, 10-guest home at this location ($90,992). The base case is the average of the two: $88,249. The two methods are 6.0% apart.

Compared with the current summer rate card: 81 Timberlane's published 16-week summer schedule totals $228,000 if every week sells. That works out to $2,036 per night across 112 nights. The rate card is $139,751 above the full-year comp-based base case. Based on the comp set's monthly AirROI revenue, 85% of annual revenue falls in Jun–Sep, about $74,594 of the base case. The rate card's nightly equivalent is 1.4x the base-case ADR ($1,483). Why the two differ: the rate card is an asking price that assumes 100% of summer weeks sell. The comps are what Airbnb listings actually earned over the last 12 months, including their unbooked nights. Weekly agency rentals like this one are not in AirROI's Airbnb data, so the comps may not reflect this property's own booking history. Use the rate card as the summer ceiling and the comp-based numbers as the year-round, nightly-rental view.

Methodology

Assumptions & Methodology

Comp selection
  • 4-7 bedrooms (subject has 4; larger homes are labeled), sleeps 7-13 (subject sleeps 10, plus or minus 3), waterfront, lake access or boat slip, rated 4.8+
  • AirROI radius search within 12 miles of the subject, entire homes only
  • Must list waterfront, lake access or a boat slip in AirROI's amenity data
  • Must have AirROI trailing-12-month revenue
  • At least 3 reviews, rated 4.8+
  • At least 30 nights booked in the last 12 months (an established, active listing)
  • Ranked by AirROI trailing-12-month average nightly rate, highest first, to represent the premium tier
Scenario math
  • Conservative: 25th percentile of comp annual revenue
  • Base: average of the comp median and AirROI's location estimate
  • Optimistic: the highest of the comp 75th percentile, AirROI's 75th-percentile estimate and the base case
  • Occupancy shown is the matching comp percentile. AirROI measures occupancy over the full year, so ADR = revenue ÷ (occupancy × 365 nights)
Data sources
  • AirROI /listings/search/radius, /listings/metrics/all and /calculator/estimate: comp revenue, occupancy, ADR, availability, monthly performance and AirROI's location estimate
  • Published rate card: Published 2027 weekly rates, Yankee Pedlar (winnire.com)
  • Raw AirROI responses are saved alongside this report
